capabilities.title: Text-to-image (Higgsfield "Soul" photoreal look + fast/turbo)
capabilities.summary: Soul is a fashion/UGC-photoreal aesthetic model. In 2026 the open-weight frontier for that look is Z-Image-Turbo (Apache-2.0, 6B, 8 steps) with "UltraReal"-style LoRAs, the brand-new FLUX 3 Image Klein (released 2026-10-15, FLUX Kommunity license), Krea 2 Turbo (aesthetics-first, 8 steps) and Qwen-Image-2512 (Apache-2.0, best prompt adherence/text among commercially clean models). Qwen Image 2.1 (2026-09-20) is the strongest all-rounder (native 2K, RGBA, up to 10 references) but is research/non-commercial only. Everything below runs on ComfyUI core nodes; most new templates are subgraphs.

comfyApi.notes: UI-format vs API-format: the frontend "Save" JSON is a LiteGraph document (nodes[] with id/type/pos/size/widgets_values, links[], groups, definitions.subgraphs, extra.ds, properties.models download hints). /prompt only accepts the API format exported via File -> Export (API): an object keyed by node id {"<id>": {"class_type": "...", "inputs": {name: value | ["<src id>", <output index>]}, "_meta": {"title": "..."}}}. Widget values become named inputs, links become [node_id, slot] pairs, and UI-only nodes (Note, MarkdownNote, Reroute, PrimitiveNode) disappear. Subgraphs (used by most 2026 templates) are flattened with composite ids such as "75:12". Converting UI->API needs /object_info to map widgets_values to input names (comfy-cli `comfy run` and the frontend do this); for Fuobe, keep exported API JSON per workflow and patch inputs by _meta.title or class_type. Video outputs in history: core SaveVideo/SaveWEBM report {"images": [{"filename", "subfolder", "type": "output"}], "animated": [true]} (ui.PreviewVideo); SaveAnimatedWEBP/PNG also use "images" + "animated"; VHS_VideoCombine (VideoHelperSuite) reports {"gifs": [{"filename", "subfolder", "type", "format": "video/h264-mp4", "frame_rate", "workflow", "fullpath"}]}; audio nodes report {"audio": [...]}; text/LLM preview nodes report {"text": [...]}. There is no "videos" key in core; treat any of images(animated)/gifs/videos defensively and download each via /view. Completion: wait for execution_success (or executing with node=null and matching prompt_id), then GET /history/{prompt_id}. Previews arrive as binary WS frames. Hosted alternatives: Comfy API v2 (jobs/assets/SSE) and an API proxy exist for running the same API-format graphs against Comfy Cloud or self-hosted servers with official Python/TypeScript SDKs.
